⟦0⟧ does not have a military of its own when it is released. It does however gain access to all division designs, technology, ship designs and tank/aircraft variants that ⟦1⟧ has upon release.
The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

Italian State of East Africa, despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands. Although being the only playable nation without any existing cores, makes up for a challenge upon maintaining peace and order on the owed lands of Ethiopia.
2nd Italo Ethiopian War and colony creation

In order to play as early as Africa Orientale Italiana(AOI), is to play first as Italy and finish the war with Ethiopia as soon as possible. Without Ethiopia having to go with the focus of government in exile, because that would prevent from AOI being formed in the first place. Thus, it benefits AOI better to start on the frontline compared to the 1939 scenario as it gets gobbled up by British and French forces in the moment when Italy joins the war with Germany. In the early scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases AOI faster, as in crowning the King of Italy as Emperor of Ethiopia. In a matter of technology, AOI also inherits whatever Italy gains from national focuses or by decision, if the player wishes to remain to play as Italy a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the puppet state, AOI gets them altogether. And, by decision Italy can send manpower to suppress resistance and send weapons.

The colony nation can be released either non aligned or fascist Italy. As it is released with the available and inherited perks as possible, the national spirit, the political advisor, the instantly formed agency and the charismatic leader contribute in generating manpower, maintaining order and keeping the colony slightly stable. Fortunately, as stated earlier, the colony nation inherits most of Italy's technology, ranging from Tanks, planes and navy. Thus, opening opportunities to start and produce if needed necessary. However, being a colony state it has many draw backs. It has a decent amount of factories but some go to the colony's overlord, and some are unusable which have to be resorted to raise compliance above 70%. Therefore, independence and high compliance mean to get the great number of factories back up. Or with other means....

So the quickest way to spawn infantry units is to use Colonial template units as they have a 6 battalion divisions and no support battalions, and place them everywhere they border the British and the French. And focus nothing more but on producing guns, and building factories manually. The war in East Africa will face AOI having to put up with numeral attacks done by the French and British in the Somaliland cores and all around the British African lands that border AOI. Counterattack once their army fatigues, and try to outmanoeuvre them for a quick encirclement as the enemy troops attack in a thin line. Push them away from Somaliland, and try to link up with the Italian forces up north reaching Egypt. And at the same time, push them away from Sudan, ensuring a direct link route with Italy on the lands of Egypt. Don't forget to secure your southern front, as they have a foothold in Kenya down to Tanzania. Keep in mind, active participation and gains against enemy forces will certainly contribute to an independent Italian State of East Africa.

AOI in order to get a faster and worthy won independence has has to follow and contribute to the capitulation of the Allies. If it has taken care of the situation in the Africa Campaign, AOI has the liberty to move their expedition to Europe. Wait long enough, and USA will eventually join the Allies, which it will make it harder for the Axis.

This requires Germany(or any Axis member) to have capitulated France had has a foothold on the French soil. Produce Transport planes, and train paratroopers, and prepare to drop from Normandy on certain tiles that are undefended, favourable in East Anglia. Otherwise, train marines and maintain naval supremacy on the English Channel, and naval invade the East British coasts. Rush down to occupy every state in the British islands before Britain reinforces their defences and makes the invasion plans futile. If possible, the Germans will come in need to support the invasion once your troops have already landed. Once the Allies have capitulated, seize all of East Africa in your possession.

After the Allies have been taken care of, Germany will declare war on USSR. This requires to take the entirety of your available troops and set them in the frontline with the USSR. Make additional gains, push further into their lands with outmanoeuvres, until the crucial cities have been taken. If contributed more than enough, AOI will gain independence by the player' decision.
